examples.arabic: ابي اشترى لي معطف حلو ليحميني من الجو العاصف والضباب برا
examples.english: My father bought me a nice coat to protect me from the windy weather and the fog outside.
examples.transliteration: abi shtara li maataf helo liyahmini men el jaw el aasef w el dabab barra

examples.arabic: كانت ليلة خريف والطقس غائم وعاصف برا
examples.english: It was an autumn night and the weather was cloudy and windy outside
examples.transliteration: Kanat laylat kharif w el taqs ghaem w aasef barra

examples.arabic: بس أحفادهم الصغار كانوا عم يتذمروا من الملل وبدهم يلعبوا برا وما فارق معهم المطر
examples.english: But their young grandchildren were complaining of boredom and wanted to play outside, not caring about the rain.
examples.transliteration: Bas ahfādhum es-sghar kanu 'am yitdhammaru min el malal w baddhum yil'abu barra w ma fareq ma'hum el matar.

examples.english: It's raining a lot outside today.
examples.transliteration: El sheti kteer barra el yom

examples.arabic: لما رجع الخط ضحكت مريم وقالت انا برا بيتك سمعت نفس الصوت وهلا رح ادخل
examples.english: When the line reconnected, Mariam laughed and said I'm outside your house, I heard the same sound, and now I'm coming in.
examples.transliteration: Lamma raja' el khatt dahaket Maryam w qalat ana barra baytak same't nafs el sawt w hala rah adkhul.

examples.arabic: اليوم في مطر كثير برا البيت
examples.english: Today there is a lot of rain outside the house.
examples.transliteration: Elyōm fī maṭar kthīr barra el-beit.
